title.narrative: Digital Transformation for Africa/ Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program SOP1

description.narrative: The SOP program development objectives (PrDO) are to increase broadband access and usage in participating countries and to promote the establishment of a single digital market in Western Africa. There are six components to the project, the first component being Enabling environment for the establishment of an African SDM. This component will support AUs strategic vision of creating an SDM in Africa by 2030 through the development of appropriate policies and regulations for coordinated digital transformation in Africa. This component includes two subcomponents: Legal and regulatory environment for a continental SDM, and Institutional capacities for a continental SDM. The second component is the connectivity market development and integration. This component aims to develop and integrate the regional connectivity market in a way that encourages private sector competition and investments. This component includes two subcomponents: legal, regulatory, and institutional capacity for telecommunications sector and digital economy, and international and core backbone network infrastructure. The third component is the data market development and integration. This component aims to build trust in online transactions and strengthen the security and resilience of digital infrastructure and systems as a prerequisite for a functional SDM. This component includes two subcomponents: data safeguards: Legal, regulatory, and institutional capacity for cybersecurity and data protection, and data enablers: Data regulations for regional data flow and data infrastructure. The fourth component is the online market development and integration. This component aims to promote creation, access and delivery of digital goods and services seamlessly and freely across the region. This component includes three subcomponents: digital adoption for regional integration: e-commerce, digital entrepreneurship, and digital skills, access to and use of digital financial services, and digital government services for regional integration. The fifth component is the project management and implementation support. This component will finance support to the recipients73 project management and implementation of project associated activities, including procurement, financial management (FM), monitoring and evaluation (M&E), project communication, environmental and social safeguards, and citizen engagement. Finally, the sixth component is the contingent emergency response component. The project will include a contingent emergency response component to help participating countries respond swiftly to eligible crises and emergencies.

The SOP program development objectives (PrDO) are to increase broadband access and usage in participating countries and to promote the establishment of a single digital market in Western Africa.The SOP1 project development objectives (PDO) are to increase broadband access and usage in participating countries and to advance integration of digital markets in Western Africa.

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the projectâ€™s contribution to increasing womenâ€™s digital finance skills through the number of beneficiaries who complete the project-suported inclusive women-focused digital finance education programs.

title.narrative: Digital startups receiving support by Entrepreneur Support Organizations (ESOs)

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the progress in the implementation of the Annual seasonal digital innovation program under subcomponent 3.1 (Digital entrepreneurship and technology adoption) which enables digital teams and/or startups to be supported by ESOs through events such as hackathons, digital open innovation initiatives, workshops, collaboration events, study visits, regional events, demo days, networking, pitching days and prototyping development.

title.narrative: Feedback addressed and responded within the stipulated service standards

comment.narrative: A grievance redress mechanism (GRM) for receiving feedback (complaints, queries, suggestions and compliments) will be established and centralized within the PIU to resolve complaints and queries and acknowledge suggestions and compliments, within service standards stipulated and communicated by the project. Since this is an indicator of transparency and citizen engagement, the PIU will commit to resolve at least 90 percent of the feedback received.

title.narrative: Grievances responded to and/or resolved within the stipulated service standards for response times published

comment.narrative: Published Reports in accordance with project established citizen feedback mechanism including detailed status of follow-up activities. The reports shall detail the feedback received from citizens, the response provided and/or action taken subsequent to the feedback received. The periodicity of the reports will be established in the citizen feedback methodology.

title.narrative: Government officials trained on key topics related to cybersecurity and data protection

comment.narrative: This indicator counts the number of government officials from the following institutions that receive training on cybersecurity, data protection and cybercrime laws from the following government agencies: Ministries of Telecommunications, Regulatory Agencies, Judiciaries, Ministries of Justice and law enforcement personnel.

title.narrative: People with certified intermediate to advanced digital skills under the project

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the projectâ€™s contribution to increasing digital skills through the number of beneficiaries who successfully complete the project's Digital Literacy Training Scheme (from intermediate to advanced digital skills), passing an exam and receiving a certificate.Intermediate digital skills: skills for more complex work or self-guided functions, such as digital marketing, desktop publishing, etc. However, they are not generally specific to ICT professions and are relevant for a wide-range of non-ICT occupations. Advanced digital skills: More Sophisticated digital skills of ICT professionals, focusing on the ability to design, develop and maintain digital tools, carrying out tasks such as web design, programming, coding and managing systems.

title.narrative: Domestic retail payment systems upgraded and/or operational

comment.narrative: This indicator tacks the progress in implementing the digital addressing system under the program, aiming at facilitating the growth of e-commerce transactions and deliveries. This entails the the acquisition of necessary equipment, tools, and platforms, as well as related TAs and capacity-building trainings.

title.narrative: Continental Grant: Mid to high-level policy makers and decision makers who completed trainings provided through SADA under the project

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of mid to high-level policymakers and decisionmakers who have been trained through capacity building courses on the principles of agile regulation for digital transformation and green digital transition to contribute to building a critical mass across the continent to support the operationalization of the AUC Digital Transformation Strategy 2020-2030.

title.narrative: Continental Grant: Mid-term evaluation report for AUâ€™s Digital Transformation Strategy 2020-2030 developed

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the carrying out of a mid-term evaluation report for AUâ€™s Digital Transformation Strategy (2020-2030) with the aim of assessing the progress and relevance of interventions made towards achieving the DTS objectives as well as documenting lessons learned in implementing DTS till now. Recommendations from this report will aid to adjust targets and approaches to achieve the DTS goals by 2030.

title.narrative: Users of G2C/G2B government services reporting satisfaction with the efficiency of the transaction

comment.narrative: This indicator will measure the percentage of users of G2C/G2B government services who report being satisfied with the efficiency of their transaction on a survey built into the services modules. The survey will be issued at the end of each transaction and the feedback from the survey will be used iteratively throughout the project to revise the digital public services as needed.

title.narrative: Continental Grant: Green Digital Infrastructure Framework Developed

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the progress in the development of a framework for promoting green digital infrastructure in Africa. This will provide guidelines and/or standards at the continental level to assist in the inclusion of green considerations in ICT policies and regulations, and to integrate the use of digital technologies in climate change policies.
